verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a pairing step or an explicit accept/approve prompt that a new device must pass before it can view or control the screen. The closest items are unattended access with a permanent password and Server Pro's per-user and device-group access control. Both are adjacent access mechanisms, not a new-device approval or pairing flow, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a power user, a new device must be paired or explicitly approved before it can see or control the screen
